items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: I knew them. I really had more to be around in that.

ctx.x: That's what he was. It was a big thing.
Did you know any of uh... Either of Louis' two last wives, Velma or uh... Uh uh... This one he had now? Uh... Lucille.

Lucille? Yeah. Yeah he had another one on here too. Used to travel with him during the 30's. They had Alva. A little short one. A little grounski one. Alva. And uh... Of course there was Lil. Yeah well Lil. Lil. He had been away from Lil. But he had Alva since then. And then Lucille came up. Uh-huh. I knew them. I really had more to be around in that. Yeah. Yeah. And then Lucille came up.
